label: Sustained mechanical power is bounded by oxygen delivery (Fick) times efficiency
statement_en: With cardiac output Q, arterial and venous O2 contents Ca ≥ Cv ≥ 0, oxycaloric equivalent E and muscular efficiency 0 ≤ η ≤ 1, aerobic mechanical power is η E Q (Ca − Cv) ≤ η E Q Ca ≤ E Q Ca. A sustained power supplied aerobically is at most η E Q Ca; sustained flight needing P_req = W v/(L/D) requires η E Q Ca ≥ P_req; climb under an aerobic supply is at most (η E Q Ca − P_req)/W. If demand and supply are power laws in size with the supply exponent below the demand exponent there is a size above which supply falls short (crossover), so Thompson's size limit holds for any supply exponent below 7/2 without the muscle premise.

hypotheses.name: aerobic-power-bound#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: Fick: O2 delivered = Q (Ca − Cv); the oxycaloric equivalent E converts O2 to metabolic power; mechanical power is at most η times it; sustained power is aerobic (anaerobic bursts, oxygen debt, and the glide phase, which needs no muscle power, are outside).

hypotheses.name: aerobic-power-bound#assumed-2
hypotheses.statement: 0 ≤ Cv ≤ Ca, 0 ≤ η ≤ 1, Q, E ≥ 0; the supply exponent is whatever the physiology gives, not derived here.

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: it applies wherever the design supplies the quantities it uses and accepts the hypotheses in scope.assumed
kernelChecked: η E Q (Ca − Cv) ≤ η E Q Ca for Cv ≥ 0 (aerobic_le_Ca); ≤ E Q Ca for η ≤ 1 (aerobic_le_metabolic); P ≤ aerobicPower ⇒ P ≤ η E Q Ca (sustained_le).
P_req ≤ P ≤ aerobicPower ⇒ P_req ≤ η E Q Ca (sustained_flight_requires); climb under aerobic supply c ≤ (η E Q Ca − P_req)/W (climb_le_aerobic).
PowerLaw demand and supply with b_supply < b_demand ⇒ ∃ L* > 0, ∀ L > L*, supply < demand (powerLaw_crossover).
assumed: Fick: O2 delivered = Q (Ca − Cv); the oxycaloric equivalent E converts O2 to metabolic power; mechanical power is at most η times it; sustained power is aerobic (anaerobic bursts, oxygen debt, and the glide phase, which needs no muscle power, are outside).
0 ≤ Cv ≤ Ca, 0 ≤ η ≤ 1, Q, E ≥ 0; the supply exponent is whatever the physiology gives, not derived here.
scope.note: This law is the SOLE owner of C14: a design whose sustained power demand exceeds the aerobic ceiling is ruled out under this law, not under fick-principle (the premise). C14b is the SAME inequality with the ceiling committed as ONE number instead of its four factors, for a design whose own oxygen chain computed it (eliminate.mjs has always implemented it, with a kernel certificate instantiating the theorem at eta = E = Q = 1 and Ca = the ceiling). It is a distinct INPUT PATH, not a duplicate: C14 needs efficiency, oxycaloric equivalent, cardiac output and arterial O2, C14b needs aerobic_ceiling_W and power_required_W. It had no row in the generated browser checker until 2026-11-01, which is why it looked like dead weight.
applies_to: sustained aerobic power DEMAND: powered level flight, climbing flight, and sustained (aerobic) swimming — work the animal must pay for out of metabolism
excludes: unpowered descent or glide: the work comes from potential and kinetic energy, not from metabolism, so W v / (L/D) computed for a descent is NOT a demand this law bounds. A real gliding flying fish compared against this ceiling comes back "violated" only because the caller converted a glide into a level-powered-flight requirement; that is an application error, not a violation (it happened to Park and Choi specimens making realistic glide claims, 2026-11-01).
burst (anaerobic) effort paid out of white-muscle stores, which is what a flying fish is understood to use for take-off and taxiing

lean.source:
/-- **Sustained flight needs enough oxygen.** If flight at speed `v` needs `P_req = W v / (L/D)` and the
sustained power is aerobic, then `P_req ≤ η E Q Ca`. -/
theorem sustained_flight_requires {W v LD P η E Q Ca Cv : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hCv : 0 ≤ Cv)
    (hsus : P ≤ aerobicPower η E Q Ca Cv) (hflight : powerRequired W v LD ≤ P) :
    powerRequired W v LD ≤ η * E * Q * Ca :=
  le_trans hflight (sustained_le hη hE hQ hCv hsus)

constraint_details.relation: η E_O2 Q Ca ≥ W v / (L/D)
constraint_details.canEliminate: a design claiming sustained powered flight its oxygen delivery cannot pay for
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C14, aerobic sustained flight.** A claim of sustained (aerobic) flight at power `P_req = W v/(L/D)` with
`η E Q Ca < P_req` is ruled out. -/
theorem aerobic_flight_rules_out {W v LD P η E Q Ca Cv : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hCv : 0 ≤ Cv)
    (hsus : P ≤ aerobicPower η E Q Ca Cv) (hflight : powerRequired W v LD ≤ P)
    (h : η * E * Q * Ca < powerRequired W v LD) : False := by
  have := sustained_flight_requires hη hE hQ hCv hsus hflight
  linarith

constraint_details.canEliminate: a design whose own oxygen chain reports a ceiling below the power its flight needs
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **Sustained power bound.** A sustained mechanical power supplied aerobically is at most `η E Q Ca`. -/
theorem sustained_le {P η E Q Ca Cv : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hCv : 0 ≤ Cv)
    (hsus : P ≤ aerobicPower η E Q Ca Cv) : P ≤ η * E * Q * Ca :=
  le_trans hsus (aerobic_le_Ca hη hE hQ hCv)
